title: Yi City
overview: Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji was led to Yi City, which is empty and in ruins.

title: Frostwork
overview: Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji meet a taoist and learn more about Yi City's story.

title: The Dream
overview: The duo uses Empathy and learn about Xiao Xingchen, Xue Yang and Yi City's past.

title: Getting Drunk
overview: The group goes to Yunping City, and Wei Wuxian discovers Lan Wangji can't handle his liquor.

title: An Old Acquaintance
overview: "Good Brother" breaks free, and they figure out his true identity.

title: The Venerated Triad
overview: Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji discover the relationship between the Clan Leaders during the Sunshot Campaign.

title: Deviated Spirit
overview: As Wei Wuxian continues to look into the past, his true identity is exposed.

title: Fated
overview: Wei Wuxian learns more about Lan Wangji's past, while a horde of Fierce Corpses heads towards the Burial Mounds.

title: Manifest
overview: Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji argue with an angry mob of cultivators before a wave of Fierce Corpses interrupts them.

title: Hatred
overview: Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji confront Jin Guangyao in the Guanyin Temple.

title: Hidden Blade
overview: Nie Mingjue's Fierce Corpse joins the final battle against the cultivators.

title: Return to Seclusion
overview: While the world reels from the aftermath of Jin Guangyao's death, Wei Wuxian, Lan Wangji, and Jiang Cheng set off on their respective journeys.
